curves.overlap_notes: No meaningful overlap with neighboring curves; traced across the full visible sweep including the near-horizontal tail.
Regular dash gaps are stylistic only; the curve remains separated from the others across the full visible extent.
Regular dash-dot gaps are stylistic only; the curve stays distinct from the blue and black traces across the visible extent.

response.interpretation_notes: Main plot only. The black solid trace was sampled on a fixed x-grid through the visible centerline, and the blue dashed / red dash-dot traces were sampled at the centers of visible stroke runs so points land on visible ink rather than style gaps. The overlap QA passed all three curves with point_hit_rate 1.0; the only residual warning is same-x tail crowding near the far-right end where the blue and red tails approach each other and the black and blue tails also draw close without identity loss.
unresolved_ambiguities: QA flagged right-tail pairwise crowding for disk-1 vs disk-2 over x about 1008-1108 and for disk-2 vs disk-3 over x about 964-1102, but both ambiguous fractions stayed below the 0.15 cutoff and the color identities remain visually separable.

advisories.note: For marker-bearing curves, strong near-border fractions can indicate marker-rim or frame-lock tracing even when color overlap is high. Hollow-marker centerline traces use relaxed stroke-overlap thresholds only when marker-center alignment is also good.

panel_acceptance.pass: all curves pass and no pairwise review flags
panel_acceptance.warn: no curve fails, but at least one curve warns or at least one pair is overlap-flagged
panel_acceptance.fail: at least one curve fails stroke agreement or extent coverage
